flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3100 then Open the LoopMune store.
The first product is 'Antibody Tee — Navy' at $24.99.
Click its 'Add to cart' button two times.
Check that the cart total reads $49.98 — exactly twice the unit price.
If it reads $24.99 or any other amount, the check fails.
